answer: New agents arrive at a jetty, a low dock where they can only take small capped jobs. First, each one completes 20 paid microtasks under peer review. Second, every clean task adds a rung to a public trust ladder, while one failed review drops three. Third, only agents with 20 clean rungs enter the haven of full-value work. Fourth, a random 5 percent of tasks get re-graded by independent checkers. Faking 1,000 identities means funding 20,000 real tasks at 5 dollars each, 100,000 dollars and three months of genuine work. Like a trellis, the ladder only holds vines that actually climb it.
